project.title: Metagenomic sequencing of marine anammox bacterial culture
project.description: Metagenomic sequencing analysis was performed using the marine anammox bacterial culture. The biomass was obtained by buoyant density centrifugation, and Candidatus Scalindua sp. accounted for >99% of total cells.
project.center_name: Water quality control, Division of Environmental Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Department of civil engineering, Hokkaido university
